answer_1.quote: In this paper, we perform a systematic study of gender biases in cross-modal generation evaluation metrics using image captioning tasks.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate five n-gram matching-based evaluation metrics (BLEU-4, METEOR, ROUGE, CIDEr, and SPICE) and one model-based metric (CLIPScore) on the PAO-EVALBIAS dataset...

answer_4.quote: We also evaluate the human correlations of each evaluation metric on Flickr8K-Expert and as present in Table 7, CLIP-Score+CIDEr achieves an improved correlation with human judgments compared to CLIPScore and CIDEr...
answer_4.guideline: The evaluation metrics' scores are correlated with human judgments on the Flickr8K-Expert dataset.
